claude-sonnet-5-5.notes: Adaptive is the default; disabled/manual thinking is unsupported. Optional between_tools omits upfront reasoning at low/medium/high only; it accepts no display, budget_tokens or block_binding. Per-message effort changes require adaptive. These are API capabilities, not Claude Code settings. Retained role efforts remain unrun workload hypotheses after recalibration.

claude-haiku-5-5.notes: API disabled thinking is allowed at low/medium/high; xhigh/max require adaptive. Manual budgets are unsupported. Claude Code prevents disabling thinking for this model. API capability does not authorize a harness control.

alaa-implementer-haiku.rationale: Automatic mechanical implementation only with an exact transformation, exclusions, finite explicitly enumerated existing-file scope and expected result; settled design with no semantic discretion; a known pattern; and cheap discriminating checks for wrong, incomplete or out-of-scope results. Every predicate is required. Many files are allowed; count alone neither qualifies nor disqualifies. Reject ambiguous matches, undefined scope or design changes. If fit ceases, stop dependent work and reclassify remaining work while preserving valid edits. No mandatory lightweight trial, replay or command-authority expansion. Unrun local user-authorized workload policy; vendor capability guidance is not calibrated comparative proof.
alaa-implementer-haiku.escalation_criterion: If any mechanical admission predicate fails or ceases to hold, stop dependent work, preserve valid edits and return remaining work for reclassification; never expand scope or command authority.

notes: Active starting hypotheses use Haiku 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1. Historical generations remain comparison snapshots only. No live calibration, account check, installation or runtime activation is implied; unavailable targets never silently fall back. Legacy replacement: every active selection request or routing reference to Haiku 4.5, including claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, selects the registered Haiku 5.5 role profile and its supported effort/thinking controls. If Haiku 5.5 is unavailable, report blocked to the lead; never select Haiku 4.5 or another fallback. Historical snapshots do not authorize active selection.
